card.title: Raise the Stakes
card.instruction: Persuade them to accept a larger risk, cost, or commitment so the outcome will feel decisive.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's make this chess game decide who cooks all weekend.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We were playing for a biscuit.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Neither of us has been emotionally changed by the biscuit.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I don't need chess to change me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then you'll enjoy discovering how much the kitchen matters.
